$comment: How est builds this plugin (sdk/cpp/build.mjs): each source compiled to wasm32 with clang, linked with EST's flags (the exported, growable table; a 64 KiB stack; est.json's memoryPagesMax as the maximum) into build/module.wasm. est.json is the only file that names the plugin: build/est_plugin.h is written from it before every build. Written by est port: "sources" is what is compiled now (the adapter passes the sound through); "port" records the original's files, copied into src/original/. Move each of "port"."sources" into "sources" when src/adapter.hpp includes its header (PORT_PLAN.md, step 2).
